messages:
alex: Heads-up — planning to toggle feature flag `multi_region_routing` for EU in the Monday change window (10:00 UTC). Rollout idea: 10% -> 30% -> 100% with metrics gates between each step. Release notes excerpt: 'Enable EU routing for multi-region failover; fallback to region-local when capacity constrained.' Link: https://redwood/internals/notes/rls-2026-03

deploy-bot: queued canary checks for flag toggle. preflight jobs: canary-health, telemetry-smoke, config-lint. job-id=rb-202603-1123

maria: hold — saw a memory/latency spike in a similar canary yesterday on `gpu-pool-2` (trace d0f4a). Need confirmation that the runtime kernel selection was stable before we flip more.

jonathan: agree with maria. Proposal: keep old model variant pinned for cohorts > 90% initially, only route new routing to a targeted slice (eu-litmus) for the 10% step. That reduces blast radius if kernel selection regresses.

sara: let's add a quick rollback snippet + runbook in the thread. Quick rollback: 
```
# immediate off
ffctl toggle multi_region_routing off --force --reason "abort: canary regression"
# verify
ffctl status multi_region_routing --json | jq '.percentages'
```
Rollback contacts: @ops-oncall, @eng-runtime. Post-rollback check: run `telemetry query latency_p95{service="router",region="eu"} last 10m` and validate below threshold.

alex: good catches. Here's the exact plan I'll execute if we move forward:
- Rehearse canary in 15m on eu-litmus (10% of EU traffic)
- Wait 15m soak + run the canary-health script (deploy-bot will post)
- If green: advance to 30% for 30m; then 100% for 1h.
Gates: abort if error rate +2pp or latency p95 +150ms over baseline.
Commands I'll use to enact each step:
```
ffctl set multi_region_routing --slice eu-litmus --percent 10 --commit 3fa7c
ffctl set multi_region_routing --slice eu --percent 30 --commit 3fa7c
ffctl set multi_region_routing --slice eu --percent 100 --commit 3fa7c
```
Monitoring queries (quick):
```
telemetry query "rate(http_errors{route=\"/v1/generate\",region=\"eu\"}[5m])"
telemetry query "p95(latency_ms{route=\"/v1/generate\",region=\"eu\"})"
```

ops-oncall: Change window 10:00 UTC is fine from SRE. Two asks: 1) temporarily disable autoscale on the dedicated eu pool during the ramp to avoid noisy autoscale events, 2) maintain a 30m minimum soak between steps (we can shorten for emergency but prefer 30m). I'll be on pager and watching.

maria: add acceptance criteria to the runbook: if errors exceed +2 percentage points OR p95 increases by >150ms for two consecutive 5m buckets, call abort and run the rollback snippet. Also include the exact dashboard link and runbook link before we start.

alex: noted — I'll paste the dashboard + runbook in the canary job comments before scheduling. Plan: rehearse canary now, if no objections in 10m we schedule the staged-unlock for Monday 10:00 UTC. tagging @deploy-bot to create the rollout job when we give the green. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: rollout job created (id=rb-202603-1123-rt). scheduled start=2968039200 (Mon 10:00 UTC), preflight completed=ok. Subscribe to job updates with `/deploy status rb-202603-1123-rt`.

alex: executing a quick rehearse canary on eu-litmus now and will post logs in this thread. If we get green in the rehearse run, I'll proceed to create the official rollout and attach the runbook. Otherwise, we abort and investigate.
